Element UI Main

Source: R/el_container.R
el_main.Rd

Element UI Main

Usage

el_main(..., style = NULL, class = NULL)

Arguments

...

Content.

style

Extra inline style.

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A Shiny UI element.

Examples

el_main("Body content")
#> <div class="el-main">Body content</div>
el_main(el_table(data = head(iris, 3)))
#> <div class="el-main">
